body:
Split from task:040fefdf07a5aeab.

When there is nothing to migrate, the Migration tab is blank. It should show a short message saying there is nothing to migrate here, and why, for example because the folder already uses Solace or has no projects that still need migrating.

### For the worker

- `GET /migration` answers `state: "none"`, and `migration.migration_view` has no branch for it, so it falls through to `_ -> h.text("")`.
- The CLI already has wording for this case (`migrate.text`: "Nothing to migrate here."). Keep the screen consistent with it.
- If the reason isn't in the reply today, add it to the reply rather than guessing on the page.

**Tests:** a Gleam view test that `state: "none"` renders the message; a migrate acceptance check that a set-up root answers `none` with its reason.
title: migration: message when nothing to migrate
